subject: literature
notes: Toru Dutt was born in Calcutta (now Kolkata), India, in 1856.
Between 1869 and 1873 she lived in France and England with her family and became fluent in French.
In 1876 she published A Sheaf Gleaned in French Fields, a collection of English translations of French poems.
She also wrote a novel in French, Le Journal de Mademoiselle d'Arvers, which was published in 1879.
Her best-known work, Ancient Ballads and Legends of Hindustan, retells Indian legends in English verse and was published in 1882.
Dutt died of tuberculosis in 1877, at the age of twenty-one; her novel and her Ancient Ballads were published after her death.
stem: The student wants to emphasize the range of Dutt's writing in light of how short her life was. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Although Dutt died at twenty-one, she left behind English translations of French poetry, a novel written in French, and a volume of English verse retelling Indian legends.
choices.B: Dutt published A Sheaf Gleaned in French Fields in 1876, only a year before she died of tuberculosis at the age of twenty-one.
choices.C: Toru Dutt was born in Calcutta in 1856 and lived in France and England between 1869 and 1873, where she became fluent in French.
choices.D: Dutt's best-known work, Ancient Ballads and Legends of Hindustan, which retells Indian legends in English verse, was published in 1882, five years after her death.

explanation.why: Two things are needed: the shortness of Dutt's life and the range of her work, meaning several different kinds of writing. Choices B and D each mention her early death with a single work, which shows no range. Only one choice lists works in different languages and forms against her age at death.
explanation.A: Correct. "Although Dutt died at twenty-one" sets up the contrast, and the three different works show the range.
explanation.B: Incorrect. It pairs her early death with a single book, so the range of her writing is missing. This is the closest near miss because it contains the "short life" half of the goal.
explanation.C: Incorrect. It gives her early life and language skills but says nothing about her writing or her death.
explanation.D: Incorrect. It names one work and notes that it appeared after her death, but one work does not show range.
